verdict.rationale: Reflect documents a vendor API with OAuth2/PKCE authentication that supports appending data to notes and returning bookmarked links, plus deep-linking URLs for triggering actions like appending to daily notes — enabling some headless write access. However, there's no evidence of read access via the API (only append/write and listing bookmarks), no MCP server, and no OpenAPI/spec discoverability (probes return 404s), making it hard for an agent to reliably read notes headlessly. missing for 10: documented read API for arbitrary notes, official MCP server, discoverable API spec (openapi/llms.txt), independent hands-on confirmation of agent integration.
